links.comparator_used: Unedited AI-generated contours containing deliberately inserted errors (mystery shopping), compared with the same contours after clinician editing
links.outcome: Proportion of inserted contouring errors removed by clinician editing
links.effect: 72% of head and neck errors and 81% of prostate errors were removed in the editing step
links.tradeoff: Anchoring bias was present when clinicians edited AI-generated contours, more pronounced for some structures than others. Some errors were not corrected (roughly 28% of head and neck and 19% of prostate errors remained).
links.quote: Most errors, however, were corrected by clinicians, with 72% of the head and neck errors 81% of the prostate errors removed in the editing step.

design_hint: clinician review and editing of AI contours (error detection)
